page: Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is an isolated, x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Edsv7 family. It features 372 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 2832.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes a substantial local storage capacity of 22677 GB utilizing NVMe SSDs, and it is Premium Storage capable. It does not contain any graphics processing units (GPUs), meaning all workloads must rely entirely on CPU-based execution.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E372ids_v7 represents a high-density resource class designed for massive workloads. The isolation of the instance ensures dedicated physical hardware, which minimizes multi-tenant interference but positions it at a higher resource tier. The lack of GPU acceleration is a notable tradeoff, rendering it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated machine learning training, though its massive memory and local NVMe storage capacity offer high density for data-heavy operations.

The hardware profile makes this instance suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and extensive data warehousing operations that require both massive memory footprints and high-capacity, low-latency local storage.
